decisions.decision: Use five production-readiness milestones: Supabase, FastAPI, Agent, UI, and Go-live.
decisions.rationale: Provides ownership while retaining an integrated launch gate.

decisions.decision: Keep the modular monolith initially, but research recommends separate Railway web and worker process roles.
decisions.rationale: Expected volume is 10-30 orders/day; durable process separation improves reliability without microservices.
Ordinary low-risk orders are autonomous; uncertainty and risky cases require human control.

decisions.decision: Pause automated replies during human handoff.
decisions.rationale: Prevents the agent from contradicting the aunt or compounding a sensitive case.

decisions.decision: Allow automatic cancellation or modification only while an order is to_do.
decisions.rationale: Later statuses imply fulfillment work and require aunt intervention.

decisions.decision: Voice notes, images, payment questions, possible reactions, angry complaints, custom requests, and unresolved uncertainty trigger handoff.
decisions.rationale: These cases exceed safe autonomous authority.

decisions.decision: Retain conversations and handoffs for 12 months, then anonymize; anonymize long-term evaluation data.
decisions.rationale: Supports improvement while limiting personal-data exposure.

decisions.decision: Use cash/manual payment and aunt-managed delivery or pickup for v1.
decisions.rationale: Avoids payment and courier expansion during the one-month production-readiness project.

decisions.decision: Use a staged pilot before public launch.
decisions.rationale: Limits customer impact while real workflows and operator readiness are proven.

decisions.decision: Treat security, observability, testing, and Meta onboarding as cross-cutting work starting before their nominal milestones.
decisions.rationale: They cannot be safely postponed to final go-live.

decisions.decision: Use interactive, standard-granularity, parallel GSD workflow with quality models, research, plan checking, verification, Nyquist validation, code review, and all PR review sections.
decisions.rationale: Production readiness requires explicit approval and strong quality gates.
